org: Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT)
title: DICT secretary says no money was stolen from accounts in reported Philippine government data breaches, GMA News reports
date_note: GMA News, published 27 November, says Secretary De Claro spoke on Thursday (26 November).
summary: GMA News reports DICT Secretary Robert Joseph De Claro said that, based on the information DICT has, no money was stolen from accounts in connection with reported data breaches at several government agencies. He said the breached information is typically already publicly available. De Claro said DICT is still examining the reported Bureau of Internal Revenue breach and will make findings public in due time.
plain: GMA News reports the Philippines' ICT secretary says no money was stolen from accounts in the reported government breaches, and the leaked information is typically already public. The BIR breach is still under examination.
exec: GMA News reports DICT says no money was stolen in the reported agency breaches so far, while the BIR case is still being examined.
